title: Director, Risk Management and Quality
text:
**Director of Risk Management and Quality**

**Who We Are:**

At Triangle Springs, we are committed to empowering and supporting a diverse and determined workforce who can drive quality, scalability, and significant impact across our hospitals and communities. In your role, you’ll support those that are in our facilities who are interfacing and providing care to our patients and community members. We believe that our collective efforts will shape a healthier future for the communities we serve. Our programs offer customized rehabilitation tailored to the specific needs of those recovering from a stroke, brain injury, neurological conditions, trauma, spinal cord injury, amputation or orthopedic injury.

**Why Choose Us:**

* Affordable medical, dental and vision plans provided to meet the needs of full-time employees and their families
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Tuition reimbursement, continuing education opportunities and apprenticeship programs for eligible employees
* 401(K) retirement plans
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts

**How you’ll contribute:**

The Director of Risk Management and Quality is responsible for the development and administration of Performance Improvement, Risk Management, and Staff Development activities throughout the hospital to ensure that all state, federal, and Joint Commission standards for care are consistently met. The Director collects and analyzes data on hospital performance, incidents, and documentation to improve hospital performance and ensure provision of quality care. The Director works closely with all department leaders to recommend and provide required staff development and tailored programs based upon data analysis. The Director monitors, investigates, and as required, reports all hospital incidents. 
 
**Essential Functions:**

To perform this job, an individual must perform each essential function satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Provides oversight and continuous monitoring of the hospital’s quality program, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and best‑practice standards.
* Demonstrates comprehensive expertise in all applicable regulatory requirements, including The Joint Commission (TJC), Medicaid, and state and federal healthcare laws.
* Serves as a key advisor to department leaders by interpreting regulatory standards, offering guidance, and supporting compliance readiness.
* Partners with hospital staff to proactively identify risk and safety concerns, leading the development and execution of corrective action plans.
* Collects, analyzes, and interprets performance data to evaluate hospital outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Oversees the incident reporting process, ensuring timely documentation, investigation, data analysis, and reporting to the Quality Council and the Chief Executive Officer.
* Utilizes the Plan‑Do‑Check‑Act (PDCA) methodology to design, implement, and measure improvement initiatives that enhance quality and patient safety.
* Ensures ongoing organizational compliance with all regulatory standards and applicable laws, maintaining survey readiness at all times.
* Always exhibit the company’s core values of champion patient care, do the right thing, embrace individuality, act with kindness, and making a difference together.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in counseling, Social Work, Nursing, or related clinical field from an accredited school required. Master’s degree in clinical field from an accredited school preferred.
* Counseling, Social Work, or Registered Nurse license preferred.
* Three years of risk management and regulatory compliance in a healthcare setting are required.
* CPR certification is required within 30 days of employment and prior to any patient contact.
* De-escalation certification is required within 30 days of employment and prior to any patient contact.

**EEOC Statement:**

Triangle Springs is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of color, race, sex, age, religion, national origin, disability, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, veterans' status or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.
